tools.name: dsh_ww_self_audit
tools.description: Run internal compliance & health self-audit on dsh-ww-auto-model-extractor (Python/JS syntax, DSH manifest contract, open-source decoders Zlib/Detex/ACL, third-party licenses, zero proprietary Oodle/key/URL leak scan).

tools.name: dsh_ww_preflight_check
tools.description: Stage 0 Preflight Gate: MUST be called BEFORE asking for a character name. Runs package self-audit, detects local official Wuthering Waves client (aborts if missing; NEVER downloads game), auto-detects and reuses existing host FModel/local keys directly (without questioning provenance), links host-provided local key path (.json/.zip/.txt/folder) with automatic AppSettings.json.bak backup, verifies key usability (reports HOST_KEYS_INVALID only if key itself is unusable), and runs isolated Blender sandbox smoke test.

game_dir.description: Optional explicit path to local official Wuthering Waves installation.

fmodel_dir.description: Optional explicit path to local FModel directory or FModel.exe.

keys_file.description: Host-provided local key path (.json, .zip, .txt/.key, or local folder containing keys.json). Pass directly without inspecting unrelated READMEs or questioning provenance; automatically backs up AppSettings.json and links local FModel.

work_dir.description: Optional output working directory (recommended outside plugin install directory).

consent_download.description: ONLY pass after explicit user approval! Comma-separated: blender,oodle,fmodel (never game).

consent_link_fmodel.description: Set true to backup AppSettings.json and link local WW directory + local keys into FModel (also auto-enabled when host explicitly supplies keys_file or local keys exist).

tools.name: dsh_ww_list_characters
tools.description: List officially released playable characters mounted in the host machine's local Wuthering Waves client (pauses if local FModel lacks valid keys so host can supply a local .json/.zip key package).

query.description: Optional character filter (Chinese input matches naming folders across Chinese, lowercase English/Pinyin, and Capitalized/PascalCase variants, e.g. 今汐->Jinxi, 长离->ChangLi, 莉莉->Lili, 琳奈->LinNai; also accepts English/ModelId).

keys_file.description: Optional host-provided local key path (.json, .zip, .txt/.key, or local folder).

tools.name: dsh_ww_extract_and_showcase
tools.description: Execute full verified stylized showcase & handoff pipeline for a released Wuthering Waves character: local key check -> parsing -> 3-tier texture audit (_N split, _SDF correlation) -> sandboxed Blender stylized toon shader + in-game animation/ribbon/facial shape keys + motion verification + preview renders + Rest-Pose FBX roundtrip -> handoff_manifest.json & Delivery Report.

character.description: Target released playable character name (e.g. 今汐, 长离, 守岸人, 爱弥斯, 莉莉, Jinxi, Lili, or ModelId).

model_path.description: Optional exact VFS .uasset path for released alternate outfits.

keys_file.description: Optional host-provided local key path (.json, .zip, .txt/.key, or local folder; pass directly without questioning origin).

consent_link_fmodel.description: Set true to backup AppSettings.json and link local WW directory + local keys into FModel.

fmodel_dir.description: Optional explicit FModel directory or FModel.exe path.

tools.name: dsh_ww_verify_delivery
tools.description: Verify an existing character deliverable directory (checks showcase .blend, preview PNGs, handoff .fbx, handoff_manifest.json, DELIVERY_REPORT.md, and runs plugin self-audit).

deliverable_dir.description: Path to the character deliverable directory containing delivery_summary.json.
